title: The pup at nine, on the ramp
logline: The pup asleep on Gully's ramp in April sun, nine, and the customers stepping over him. The ramp was built for a dog with three legs in 2014; this one uses it for naps.

panels.composition: A small three-legged dog asleep on a plank ramp at a bait shack's door in April sun, a customer's legs stepping over it, the dock beyond.
